bound_basis.input: Final HTTP JSON body UTF-8 bytes plus 8192 framing tokens; text-only, two messages, schema included. Byte BPE cannot require more ordinary text tokens than bytes; allowance covers the inspected fixed role/thinking/schema wrappers.
bound_basis.price: Default 5-minute cache: uncached, cached and cache-write token classes are mutually exclusive. Maximum input price is $3/M; cache discounts ignored. Non-default cache settings are rejected before dispatch.
bound_basis.output: Wire max_tokens/max_completion_tokens caps reasoning_content plus content together; reserve the whole cap at $15/M.
bound_basis.failures: Every outgoing HTTP attempt, including retries, is reserved first. Unknown/failed usage retains its full reservation. No invoice or exact cache-aware cost is claimed.
